source_name: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 4 Chapter 11 (N2O from managed soils, CO2 from lime and urea)
read_from: Table 11.1 (page 11.11) and Table 11.3 (page 11.24), read from the published pages

conversion.note: N2O = N2O-N x 44/28, as stated under Equation 11.1

EF1.unit: kg N2O-N per kg N applied
EF1.applies_to: synthetic fertiliser, organic amendments, crop residues, mineralised N

EF1FR.unit: kg N2O-N per kg N applied

EF3PRP_CPP.unit: kg N2O-N per kg N deposited
EF3PRP_CPP.applies_to: cattle (dairy, non-dairy, buffalo), poultry and pigs on pasture

EF3PRP_SO.unit: kg N2O-N per kg N deposited

EF4.unit: kg N2O-N per kg NH3-N + NOx-N volatilised

EF5.unit: kg N2O-N per kg N leached or run off

FracGASF.unit: kg N volatilised per kg synthetic N applied

FracGASM.unit: kg N volatilised per kg organic N applied or deposited

FracLEACH_H.unit: kg N lost per kg N added
FracLEACH_H.applies_to: regions where rainfall exceeds soil water holding capacity, or where irrigation other than drip is used. Elsewhere the default is zero.
